decision.reasoning_trace: During my search for a Bluetooth speaker, I had to filter through several listings that were actually protective cases or replacement parts rather than the speakers themselves. I narrowed my consideration set to five viable options ranging from budget-friendly outdoor speakers to more premium models. The INSMY (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) was a strong contender due to its low price and high review count, but I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 4 Renewed (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013). JBL is a highly reputable brand for portable audio, and getting a Charge 4 at $89.95 with a 4.7-star rating represents excellent value for someone looking for superior sound quality and durability.
